lemmas.primary_translation: to distribute so thinly among many recipients that each receives little

definitions.text: fordele til så mange mottakere at det blir lite på hver
definitions.translation: distribute among so many recipients that each receives little (lit. spread thinly over)

examples.no: midlene blir smurt tynt utover på mange mottakere
examples.en: The funds are spread thinly across many recipients.
